title: Dr. Deepu R
content:
Dr. Deepu R

Experience Profile

  • Currently working as Professor in Department of CSE and Head for Department of Career Guidance & Placements at ATME College of Engineering, Mysore since October 2021. Responsible for Preparing Training Modules, conduct Communication, Aptitude & Soft skills training for all 4 years of engineering students towards their career building and conducting placement drives.
  • Worked as Professor in Department of Computer Science & Engineering at MIT, Mysore. Worked as Assistant/Associate Professor and Head in Department of Computer Science & Engineering at MIT, Mysore from July 2008 to September 2021. Responsible for building department as per NBA requirements. Was HOD of CSE during 2008 to 2020. Relieved on 17th September 2021.
  • September, 2007 – July 2008, worked as Senior Lecturer in CSE Dept., at Auden Technology and Management Academy (ATMA), Kanakapura Road, Bangalore.
  • August 2005 – Sept 2007 Worked as Senior Lecturer in CSE Dept., at New Horizon College of Engineering, Bangalore. Other responsibilities include ISO & NBA related works.
  • 2001 July - July 2005 worked at Vidya Vikas Educational Trust Polytechnic as HOD in CSE\ISE.
  • July 2000 – July 2001 at Zap Infotech, Bangalore as Project Consultant.
  • Oct 1999 – Augu 2000 worked at Vidya Vikas Institute of Engineering& Technology, Mysore as Lecturer in CSE.
